canonical:
glassbox-canonical 1
version 2
id "heating"
title "Heating controller"
clock minutes
initial "off"
notes 25
  note "This is the CENTRAL HEATING circuit only, and that restriction is the"
  note "finding. A real boiler serves two circuits — heating and hot water — which"
  note "run independently: the water can be reheating while the radiators are"
  note "satisfied, and either can be boosted without the other. They are not two"
  note "modes of one machine, they are two machines sharing a boiler."
  note ""
  note "The format cannot say that. Its options are both bad. Model the product —"
  note "off, ch-only, hw-only, both — and six honest states become twenty-four,"
  note "then multiply again if a third zone is ever added. Or write two artifacts,"
  note "which is correct, and then discover the format has no way to state that two"
  note "machines run together, share facts, and contend for one boiler."
  note ""
  note "This is the AND-state, and it was predicted: the earlier design notes call"
  note "concurrent machines alongside a mode machine exactly that, and answer it"
  note "with 'one machine, several instances sharing an environment'. That answer"
  note "is still right and is still not implemented — `worldFrom` makes one world"
  note "for one machine, and nothing composes two."
  note ""
  note "So the honest artifact is one circuit, and the missing feature has a name."
  note ""
  note "Commands here are the cleanest case in the corpus, because the boiler is a"
  note "genuinely two-valued thing: four of the six states want it off and two want"
  note "it on, and each says so on entry. It also has the corpus's most defensible"
  note "exit command — leaving Fault clears the lockout, and there is exactly one"
  note "way out of Fault, so no neighbouring state can disagree about it."
states 6
  state "boosting" "Boost" false (entry 2 "pump-on" "burner-on") (exit 0)
  state "fault" "Fault" false (entry 3 "burner-off" "pump-off" "latch-fault") (exit 1 "clear-fault")
  state "frost" "Frost watch" false (entry 2 "burner-off" "pump-off") (exit 0)
  state "heating" "Heating" false (entry 2 "pump-on" "burner-on") (exit 0)
  state "off" "Off" false (entry 2 "burner-off" "pump-off") (exit 0)
  state "satisfied" "Up to temperature" false (entry 2 "burner-off" "pump-off") (exit 0)
events 8
  event "boost" "boost" user
  event "boost-over" "boost elapsed" runtime
  event "calls" "thermostat calls" runtime
  event "cancel" "cancel boost" user
  event "faults" "boiler fault" runtime
  event "mode" "mode" user
  event "reset" "reset" user
  event "satisfies" "thermostat satisfied" runtime
config 2
  config "boost-minutes" "Boost lasts (minutes)" (num 60)
  config "has-frost-watch" "Frost protection fitted" (bool true)
facts 2
  fact "below-frost" "It is cold enough to worry about pipes"
  fact "scheduled-on" "The timer says it should be on"
refusals 3
  refusal "in-fault" "the boiler has locked out; reset it first"
  refusal "no-frost" "this controller has no frost protection"
  refusal "not-boosting" "no boost is running"
commands 6
  command "burner-off" "Shut the burner down"
  command "burner-on" "Fire the burner"
  command "clear-fault" "Clear the fault lockout"
  command "latch-fault" "Latch the fault and light the lamp"
  command "pump-off" "Stop the circulating pump"
  command "pump-on" "Run the circulating pump"
rules 48
  rule "boosting" "boost" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "boosting" "boost-over" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "scheduled-on")) (move "heating")) (case - (move "satisfied")))
  rule "boosting" "calls" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "boosting" "cancel" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "scheduled-on")) (move "heating")) (case - (move "satisfied")))
  rule "boosting" "faults" (cases 1 (case - (move "fault")))
  rule "boosting" "mode" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "boosting" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "boosting" "satisfies" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "fault" "boost" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "in-fault")))
  rule "fault" "boost-over" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "fault" "calls" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "fault" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "in-fault")))
  rule "fault" "faults" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "fault" "mode" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "in-fault")))
  rule "fault" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "fault" "satisfies" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "frost" "boost" (cases 1 (case - (move "boosting")))
  rule "frost" "boost-over" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "frost" "calls" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "frost" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-boosting")))
  rule "frost" "faults" (cases 1 (case - (move "fault")))
  rule "frost" "mode" (cases 1 (case - (move "satisfied")))
  rule "frost" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "frost" "satisfies" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "heating" "boost" (cases 1 (case - (move "boosting")))
  rule "heating" "boost-over" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "heating" "calls" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "heating" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-boosting")))
  rule "heating" "faults" (cases 1 (case - (move "fault")))
  rule "heating" "mode" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "heating" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "heating" "satisfies" (cases 1 (case - (move "satisfied")))
  rule "off" "boost" (cases 2 (case (not (holds (config "has-frost-watch"))) (refuse "no-frost")) (case - (move "boosting")))
  rule "off" "boost-over" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "calls" (cases 2 (case (and 2 (holds (config "has-frost-watch")) (holds (fact "below-frost"))) (move "frost")) (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-boosting")))
  rule "off" "faults" (cases 1 (case - (move "fault")))
  rule "off" "mode" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "scheduled-on")) (move "heating")) (case - (move "satisfied")))
  rule "off" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "off" "satisfies" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "satisfied" "boost" (cases 1 (case - (move "boosting")))
  rule "satisfied" "boost-over" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "satisfied" "calls" (cases 2 (case (holds (fact "scheduled-on")) (move "heating")) (case - (stay)))
  rule "satisfied" "cancel" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "not-boosting")))
  rule "satisfied" "faults" (cases 1 (case - (move "fault")))
  rule "satisfied" "mode" (cases 1 (case - (move "off")))
  rule "satisfied" "reset" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "satisfied" "satisfies" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
deadlines 1
  deadline "boosting" "boost-over" (config "boost-minutes")
